focal_point: A house photo and a storm headline share the card with an offer tile.
eye_path: Z: headline, roof, offer tile, phone.
grid: Photo with a corner or band offer. Vendor-typical.
scale_ratios: Headline and offer tile are close. Not a 1.6× numeral.
type_choices: Bold sans, several sizes, high-contrast tile.
photo_art_direction: Whole house or roof, somewhat generic at this resolution. Not a crew close-up.
offer_placement: Tile is visible and is the right idea, crowded by the headline.
trust_and_cta: Phone near the tile. Limited proof.

hierarchy.reason: Tile is not clearly larger than the headline.

photo.reason: Roof is shown; crop is average.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets storm plus a deal.

emulate: An offer tile on the quiet part of a roof photo, then make the numeral actually bigger than the headline.
do_not_copy: Headline wording, phone, any storm claim.
summary: Low-resolution storm roofing card. The tile idea is right and the execution is template.
